src: per-turn data: catalog/clones/<id>.md clone card (apps/frontend/packages/site-kit/src/catalog.ts cloneFile)
text: ## Slots — Set a slot in `slots` to change it; leave it out to keep the original exactly. … | slot | kind | original | … ## Other visible text (no slot) — Change any of these with `replacements`, using the exact text as `find`.
note: Every clone keeps the seller's own published words, stats, customer names and quotes unless the agent changes them. The site's "Use only the facts in your workspace" rule does not name these clone words as a source.
